sentences.text: Jinbeisaurus was a small to medium-sized theropod dinosaur.

It is distinguished by a wide interfenestral bar, a deep fossa at the base of the septum between the promaxillary recess and maxillary antrum, a low dorsal row of tooth sockets, similar denticle counts per unit length on the mesial and distal carinae of upper and lower teeth, and an acute angle of approximately 70 degrees between the posterior foot process and the pubis axis.
Jinbeisaurus is the first non-avian theropod dinosaur named from Shanxi Province.
This animal lived at the end of the Cretaceous Period, approximately 80 million years ago during the Campanian stage.
A 2025 paper by Zanno and Napoli recovered Jinbeisaurus alongside Bistahieversor as basal albertosaurines.
